messages:
Nora (CS): quick alert 1: 9 onboarding tenants reporting empty indexes after last night's schema migration. need an external status + RCA cadence.
Sam (CS): how many are fully blocked vs degraded? any high-touch accounts?
Nora (CS): 3 blocked activations (AlphaCorp, BeaconEd, Lexico). rest can search but missing recent docs. ticket has full list.
Vega (Eng): triage: migration's compact pass dropped small write batches when TTL compaction collided with in-flight indexing. applied a targeted bypass at 04:12 UTC and restarted the reingest workers.
Vega (Eng): reingest rate ~420 docs/min for priority tenants; estimating ~1.5-2 hours to clear top three queues. will post updates every 30m.
Raj (Product): comms recs: (1) short status email with ETA and contact path, (2) offer 1 platform day credit to blocked activations, (3) host a 30m office hour for technical questions.
Nora (CS): draft external: "We've identified delayed/missing document indexing after a scheduled migration. Engineers have applied a mitigation and reindexing is underway. Priority activation tenants should be caught up within ~2 hours. We'll follow up with a full RCA and a scheduled office hour."
Sam (CS): good. add a direct reply path and incident page link. also note credit offer for blocked activations.
status-bot: Hotfix v2026.8.01-compact-bypass deployed to prod at 1745554300. All checks passed. :white_check_mark:
Vega (Eng): long-term fixes: avoid concurrent TTL compaction + reindex windows, add per-tenant ingest throttles, and alert on sudden queue growth. drafting infra section for RCA.
Nora (CS): I'll send the status email in 8m and own the external thread. Sam please handle AlphaCorp replies; I'll take BeaconEd; Raj will coordinate office hour invite. tagging follow-ups: @Vega infra RCA, @Raj office hour + feedback poll, @Sam per-tenant reply log.
Sam (CS): on it. I'll update ticket with customer responses.
